decks.name: Tones
decks.desc: The silent tone letter: pob, poj, pov, po, pos, pog, pom, and common words for each of the eight tone spellings

decks.name: Consonants and vowels
decks.desc: RPA letters English reads wrong (x, s, z, r, c, q, w), puffs of air (ph, th, kh), nasal starts (np, nt, nk), breathy nasals (hm, hn), and the vowels ee, oo, ia, ua

decks.name: Greetings and courtesy
decks.desc: Nyob zoo, ua tsaug, thov txim, sib ntsib dua: hello, thanks, sorry and goodbye the way Hmong Americans say them

decks.name: About me
decks.desc: I, you, he and she (and the "two of us" words), your name, where you are from, your clan, your languages, work and school

decks.name: Family and kinship
decks.desc: Parents, children, brothers and sisters (the word depends on who is speaking), grandparents, uncles, aunts and in-laws

decks.name: Numbers and money
decks.desc: Counting from one to a million, caug and caum for the tens, puas and pua for the hundreds, dollars and "how many?"

decks.name: Things and classifiers
decks.desc: Everyday things with their counting word: lub tsev, daim ntawv, rab riam, txoj hlua, phau ntawv, nkawm khau

decks.name: Food and drink
decks.desc: Rice, vegetables, meat, fish, eggs, noodles, chili, water, tea and coffee; noj for eating and haus for drinking

decks.name: Time and days
decks.desc: Today, yesterday, tomorrow, morning to night, days and months, clock hours, years, and every day

decks.name: Feelings and weather
decks.desc: Happy, sad, angry, lonely, scared, shy and tired; rain, wind, hot, cold and warm

decks.name: Getting around
decks.desc: Up there, down there, over there, inside, outside, left and right, near and far, cars, planes and roads

decks.name: Shopping and money
decks.desc: The market, prices, expensive and cheap, paying, buying, selling, discounts, and saying "more than"

decks.name: Health and help
decks.desc: Feeling sick, the doctor, the clinic and the pharmacy, fever and cough, medicine, appointments, interpreters, and asking for help

decks.name: Talking with elders
decks.desc: Greeting grandparents when they arrive and leave, "have you eaten?", respectful address, and the soft os

decks.name: New Year and celebrations
decks.desc: Noj peb caug: the ball toss, the qeej, paj ntaub, the silver sash, new clothes, songs, and happy birthday

decks.name: Family events
decks.desc: Clan, weddings and family gatherings, blessings and the wrist-string tie, and how families celebrate together

decks.name: Questions and connectors
decks.desc: What, who, where, when, how many, why, the puas and los questions, and the words for and, but, because and or

decks.name: Traps for English speakers
decks.desc: Tone twins (pob, pov, pog), the right counting word, no "is" before an adjective, peb or wb, and who says nus or kwv
